key_insight: QUANTA combines specialized AI agents with deterministic instrument-action validation to enable closed-loop quantum-materials characterization.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a path to automating expertise-intensive measurement workflows on a widely adopted Physical Property Measurement System (PPMS).
method: Retrieve evidence from scientific literature, experimental protocols and prior measurements.
Coordinate specialized agents for experimental planning, troubleshooting and data interpretation.
Validate instrument actions deterministically and revise measurement plans using incoming data.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports demonstrations through transport measurements of the Weyl semimetal TaP and investigations of nonlinear responses in magnetic Co2MnGa, without quantitative performance metrics.
watch_item: Generalization beyond the demonstrated materials and PPMS workflows requires further validation.
paper_title: Autonomous Quantum Measurement with Agentic AI
